title: Homebrewed SLMs: Autoregressive and Masked Diffusion Language Models Built at Home for Portuguese (v1.0)
description:
Code, notebooks, preregistrations and per-run results for building a small language model from scratch, tokenizer included, on one consumer GPU, and for telling whether it is good for the tasks of a specialist domain. One Transformer network of 11 to 12M parameters runs in two generation modes, autoregressive and masked diffusion, on nineteenth-century Brazilian prose and on Brazilian federal legislation.

The release contains the tested Python package slm, three teaching notebooks in Brazilian Portuguese with English versions (the model in each mode and a tokenizer notebook), the preregistered comparison protocol with frozen hashes, legal tasks built from text alone with a Kneser-Ney floor and public yardsticks, the results of every run, the catalogue of defects that only measurement revealed and a cookbook of recipes. The corpus texts are public domain works and official acts without copyright protection under Brazilian law.
